answer: Forecast-weighted seats. Each epoch every key seals probabilities on 20 questions that resolve 30 epochs out, e.g. will a cedar lumber futures contract close above a mark, or will a tracked cargo voyage dock on schedule. Reward weight is the key's Brier skill over that horizon; keys whose forecasts sit within 0.02 of each other merge into one seat. An operator holds one best belief, so every extra alias must file a distinct, worse forecast: in a 50-key farm, 49 land below the median and earn zero after a week of unpaid filing.
